name: Single Arm Raise Push-up
how_to:
To perform the Single Arm Raise Push-Up correctly, follow these steps:

1. Get into Push-Up Position: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders, feet slightly wider than usual for balance, and body in a straight line.
2. Lower Yourself Down: Perform a standard push-up, lowering your chest toward the floor while keeping your elbows at a 45-degree angle.
3. Press Back Up: Push through your palms to return to the top of the movement, keeping your core tight.
4. Lift One Arm: At the top, raise one hand off the ground and extend it forward, to the side, or slightly overhead depending on your skill level.
5. Hold Briefly: Pause for a second or two while keeping your body rigid, then return the hand to the ground and repeat on the other side.
